name: radio-medical-prompt-evals
description: Promptfoo contract tests for Radio Medical AI review and response chains

scripts.test:prompts: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true sh -c 'promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.review.yaml && promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.response.yaml'
scripts.test:prompts:review: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.review.yaml
scripts.test:prompts:response: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.response.yaml
scripts.test:prompts:all: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml
